card.name: The word today in general text
card.fires_on: The word "today", mostly in "today's" after in, of, or at, and also at the end of a phrase such as "in use today". It appears in general web text, not drug-label text.

modes.label: Today's as a possessive
modes.description: "today" followed by 's, describing the present-day world, landscape or setting.

modes.label: Today ending a phrase
modes.description: "today" closing a phrase to mean at the present time, or as a call to act now.
modes.example: Subscribe<< today>> and save! | The world's best

card.plain: It marks the word "today" when it means the present time, as in "in today's world" or "in use today".
